title: Acknowledgments
body_md:
The authors acknowledge helpful conversations with Jackie Lok and Samuel Greene.

During the preparation of this work, the authors used ChatGPT to improve the writing and mathematical results, and Claude to improve the code.
The main theorems were developed before AI tools were used, although AI-assisted revisions improved their constants or rates.
The authors independently verified all proofs and computational results and take full responsibility for the published work.

This work was supported in part through the NYU IT High Performance Computing resources, services, and staff expertise.
